data.text: Demo risk on main (ad996a1, default config, mock model): POST /api/input "We need coffee" returns needs_clarification, "Connect your Oda account", because ODA_FOOD_ENABLED defaults to true and Oda signup is deferred. No proposal, order or Work item is created. Tests don't cover this: conftest sets ODA_FOOD_ENABLED=false. Set it to false for the fixture coffee flow, or connect Oda before demoing. Noah: relevant to ordering-merged-live-verification.
